key_concepts: Concentration is the quantity of solute in a given quantity of solvent or solution
Diluted solution has less solute than solvent
Concentrated solution has greater solute than solvent
Concentration can be expressed quantitatively by percent by mass and percent by volume
Percent by mass is the mass of solute per 100 grams of solution
Mass of solution equals mass of solute plus mass of solvent
Percent by volume is used when solute and solvent are liquids
Volume of solution equals volume of solute plus volume of solvent
Percent concentration is calculated as solute amount divided by solution amount times 100
Adding more solute or less solvent increases concentration
Percent concentration can be used to find the amount of solute in a solution
